newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 15.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Friday:
- The first group of U.S. soldiers arrived in Rwanda to prepare for the rescue of Rwandan refugees in eastern Zaire.
- The Central Intelligence Agency helped free a retired Russian spy after the Federal Bureau of Investigation arrested him for allegedly trying to steal state secrets.
- The divide between north and south in Italy has never been greater.
- The United Network for Organ Sharing has changed the rule for organ donations, giving patients with the best chance of survival the highest priority.
- Chicago Roman Catholic Archbishop Joseph Cardinal Bernardin died at home at the age of 68.
- William Cohen, a retiring Republican Senator from Maine, appears to be a likely candidate for Secretary of Defense.
- A cult group whose arms cache was uncovered by police in New York used to recruit idealistic college students.
